target_include_directories(WeftRISCVTarget PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  ${WEFT_RISCV_EXTENSION_REGISTRY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(WeftRISCVTarget PUBLIC
  WeftAnalysis
  WeftPhysicalTransforms
  WeftSourceSpecialization
  WeftRISCVPlatform
  WeftRISCVContracts
  WeftKernelDialect
  WeftRISCVDialect
  MLIRArithDialect
  MLIRAsmParser
  MLIRIR
  MLIRPass
  MLIRSCFDialect
  MLIRSCFTransforms
  MLIRTransforms
)

if(LLVM_LINK_LLVM_DYLIB)
  llvm_config(WeftRISCVTarget USE_SHARED TargetParser)
else()
  llvm_config(WeftRISCVTarget TargetParser)
endif()
